title: beta-Elemene in zedoary turmeric oil injection induces dyspnea by binding to hemoglobin and upregulating HIF-1alpha.
authors: Wang, Zhenzhen; Wang, Aiting; Wang, Xiaofang; Yang, Zhirui; Yan, Yan; Tian, Shuhong; Chen, Wei; Yan, Dan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究莪术油注射液中β-榄香烯与血红蛋白结合并上调HIF-1α导致呼吸困难，虽涉及蛋白-小分子结合与分子对接，但对象为血红蛋白而非转录因子-DNA互作，方法以实验为主，仅分子对接辅助，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Zedoary turmeric oil injection (ZTOI) extracted from the rhizome extract of Curcuma phaeocaulis Valeton, Curcuma wenyujin Y. H. Chen et C. Ling or Curcuma kwangsiensis S. G. Lee et C. F. Liang, is widely used for the treatment of virus-induced upper respiratory tract infections, peptic ulcers, viral pneumonia, etc. However, it has attracted widespread attention because it often causes adverse drug reactions (ADRs), including dyspnea. However, little is known about the mechanism underlying dyspnea caused by ZTOI, which limits its clinical application. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the major pathophysiologic signatures and underlying mechanism of ZTOI-related dyspnea. METHODS: Respiratory function detection was used to explore the pathophysiologic signature of dyspnea induced by ZTOI. UV-vis absorption spectroscopy and isothermal titration calorimetry were applied to test the interaction between ZTOI and hemoglobin (Hb). GC‒MS was used to identify the main components in ZTOI. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, and circular dichroism spectroscopy were employed to test the reaction between beta-elemene and Hb. Western blot was performed to investigate the effect of beta-elemene on the hypoxia signaling pathway. RESULTS: The results showed that ZTOI-induced dyspnea was related to a decreased oxygen carrying capacity of Hb. The molecular interaction between ZTOI and Hb was proven. Notably, beta-elemene in ZTOI exhibited high binding affinity to Hb and altered its secondary structure. Furthermore, it was found that beta-elemene downregulated the expression of prolyl hydroxylase-domain protein 2 and upregulated the expression of hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha. CONCLUSIONS: Our study is valuable for better understanding the pathophysiological characteristics and underlying mechanism of ZTOI to ensure its safe clinical application. We also provided a strategy to elucidate the underlying mechanism based on inspiration from clinical ADR phenotypes for investigating other medical products with ADRs in the clinic.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：从莪术（Curcuma phaeocaulis Valeton）、温郁金（Curcuma wenyujin Y. H. Chen et C. Ling）或广西莪术（Curcuma kwangsiensis S. G. Lee et C. F. Liang）的根茎提取物中提取的莪术油注射液（ZTOI），广泛用于治疗病毒性上呼吸道感染、消化性溃疡、病毒性肺炎等。然而，由于其常引起包括呼吸困难在内的药物不良反应（ADRs），已引起广泛关注。然而，关于ZTOI引起呼吸困难的机制知之甚少，这限制了其临床应用。研究目的：探讨ZTOI相关呼吸困难的主要病理生理特征及其潜在机制。方法：采用呼吸功能检测探讨ZTOI所致呼吸困难的病理生理特征。采用紫外-可见吸收光谱和等温滴定量热法检测ZTOI与血红蛋白（Hb）之间的相互作用。采用GC-MS鉴定ZTOI中的主要成分。采用分子对接、表面等离子体共振和圆二色光谱检测β-榄香烯与Hb之间的反应。采用Western blot研究β-榄香烯对缺氧信号通路的影响。结果：结果表明，ZTOI诱导的呼吸困难与Hb携氧能力下降有关。ZTOI与Hb之间的分子相互作用得到证实。值得注意的是，ZTOI中的β-榄香烯对Hb表现出高结合亲和力，并改变了其二级结构。此外，发现β-榄香烯下调脯氨酰羟化酶域蛋白2的表达，并上调缺氧诱导因子-1α的表达。结论：我们的研究对于更好地理解ZTOI的病理生理特征和潜在机制以确保其临床安全应用具有重要价值。我们还提供了一种基于临床ADR表型启发来阐明潜在机制的策略，用于研究临床上具有ADRs的其他医疗产品。
